integration_issues.flow: Shareable deep-link cold load (full page reload to /drill, /agent/:id, /payment/:id while authenticated)
integration_issues.issue: URL oscillates between the deep-link path and '/' indefinitely after a cold reload. Observed for all three routes. The skip-first-run guard (didTabUrlSync ref) in Layout.js effect (2) is not preventing the loop — tab->URL keeps navigating to '/' while URL->tab keeps activating the deep-link tab. Effectively the deep-link route renders briefly then bounces back to Dashboard, then back to the deep link, repeatedly. Pasting a shared URL therefore does NOT reliably land the recipient on the intended view.

action_items: FIX deep-link cold-load oscillation in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.js. Likely causes to investigate: (a) didTabUrlSync ref is reset by Suspense fallback/lazy-chunk remount of Layout, so 'first run' fires twice — after Layout remounts post-hydration the guard is consumed again; (b) the URL->tab effect either creates a NEW tab (when key not in persisted set) or activates an existing one — when openTab path is taken the new tab id differs from persisted activeId, which causes tabsApi.activeId to flip back to the previously persisted Dashboard before settling, triggering tab->URL with active=Dashboard; (c) effect (2) compares currentSpec.key === active.key but currentSpec may be null briefly during route transition (e.g. when location.pathname is '/' from a transient navigate('/')), so the guard short-circuits in the wrong direction. Recommended fix: in effect (2), explicitly skip navigation if specFromLocation(location) is non-null AND the active tab's key matches the URL spec key; also debounce / coalesce activeId changes within a single tick; consider using a stable 'lastSyncedKey' ref instead of a one-shot boolean.

After fix, re-test: full reloads to /drill?kind=metric&metric=open_pipeline&title=Open+Pipeline, /agent/<id>?name=..., /payment/<id> — each URL must remain stable for >=5s post-load with the corresponding data-testid visible.
Also re-test rapid tab-strip switching across already-open tabs after fix to ensure regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js effect (2): the one-shot didTabUrlSync ref guards only the very first run; if Layout remounts (Suspense boundary, route-level lazy import, HMR), the guard is reset and the next pass will navigate(tabToPath(active)) — which on a deep link race condition will overwrite the URL with the persisted active tab's URL ('/').

Layout.js effect (1): when location matches a spec whose key is not yet in tabs (cold deep link with empty persisted state), openTab(spec) is called. openTab in TabsContext both creates the tab AND sets it active. But there's a brief render where activeId is still the old (persisted) value before setActive flushes — during that render effect (2) will see active=oldTab and navigate to oldTab's URL, kicking off the loop.

Recommended pattern: replace didTabUrlSync boolean with an effect that tracks lastUrlSyncedKey and only navigates when active.key !== lastUrlSyncedKey AND active.key !== specFromLocation(...).key. Alternatively, gate the tab->URL effect with a small useEffect [location.key] guard so it only runs after a tab-driven activeId change, not after a URL-driven one.

rca of the issue: URL<->tab feedback loop on cold deep-link load. Logs of page.url every 0.8s on goto('/drill?kind=metric&metric=open_pipeline...'): /->/drill->/->/drill->/drill->/->/->/drill (continuous). Same pattern for /agent/<id> and /payment/<id>. Root cause hypothesis: (1) Layout.js useEffect 'tab->URL' uses a one-shot didTabUrlSync ref that is reset whenever Layout remounts (Suspense boundary around TabHost lazy chunks, /drill,/agent,/payment lazy routes). After the lazy chunk resolves and Layout re-mounts, the guard fires again and the effect's next pass sees the persisted active tab (Dashboard) and navigates('/'), erasing the deep link. (2) URL->tab effect then re-activates the deep-link tab from the new URL, but the tab is created via openTab which momentarily leaves activeId pointing at the previously-persisted Dashboard before flushing — that interim render triggers tab->URL again with active=Dashboard. Mitigation: replace the boolean skip with a key-stable lastSyncedKey ref OR gate effect (2) so it only runs when tabsApi.activeId changes due to a user/tab-driven action (not when it changes due to effect (1)'s URL->tab activation). A clean implementation: track 'urlDrivenActivation' via a ref set inside effect (1) before calling setActive/openTab and consumed at the top of effect (2).
